references.text: Moses recounts how the people asked to send spies to explore the land, and how he chose twelve men, one from each tribe.
God's promise to give the land of Canaan to Abraham's descendants is the background for sending out the spies.
God promised to give the entire land of Canaan to Abraham and his offspring as an eternal possession.
God declares His intention to bring the children of Israel out of Egypt and into the land of Canaan.
Moses gives the spies instructions on what they should investigate in the land.
A回顾 of when the spies were sent from Kadesh-Barnea to explore the land.
Joshua also sends spies to explore the land, especially Jericho, before the conquest.
The book of Hebrews refers to the generation that came out of Egypt and did not enter the land because of unbelief following the spies' report.
